hypotheses.N0_double_source_closure_is_exact: Float64 additive state closure is at most 1e-10 and finite output Shapley closure at most 1e-6; raw native-attention versus edge-sum discrepancy remains below 5e-4.
hypotheses.N1_source_shares_are_precision_stable: Every carried, boundary-attention, nonboundary-attention, and MLP projection share changes by at most 0.02 from the float32 run.
hypotheses.N2_carried_and_attention_conclusion_surv: Carried share remains at least 0.30 and combined attention at least 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.N3_nonboundary_attention_conclusion_surv: Nonboundary attention exceeds boundary attention in signed mean in every cell.
hypotheses.N4_final_MLP_is_negligible: Absolute final-MLP projection share is below 0.05 in every cell.
